claims.contradiction_strategy: prefer newer authoritative claims with stronger observation support
claims.update_rule: update existing memory when the code area or logical subsystem already has coverage; create new memory when the scope differs materially

privacy.promotion_rule: private claims may be promoted to shared after explicit review and redaction

entity_types.name: discovery
entity_types.description: Durable learning from exploration that future agents should reuse

relation_types.name: derived_from
relation_types.description: Artifact was produced from an upstream artifact

relation_types.name: supersedes
relation_types.description: New claim replaces previous claim version

relation_types.name: supports
relation_types.description: Source or observation supports a claim
